sloka: इदम् तावद्यथाकाममीश्वरस्य कृते कृतम् ।रामस्य तु परित्यागे न हेतुम् उपलक्षये ॥२-५८-२९॥
transliteration: idam tāvadyathākāmamīśvarasya kṛte kṛtam ।rāmasya tu parityāge na hetum upalakṣaye ॥2-58-29॥

translations.english: 'Or he might have thought he is the overlord and can do as he likes. (Or, he might have done this for fear of God) Otherwise, I do not see any reason for the abandonment of Rama'.
